caption: The drawing depicts a cast iron mechanical bank shaped to resemble a military scene. On the left side, there is a rectangular structure that looks like a brick fortress or tower, featuring a recessed opening near the top and an etched brick pattern on its surface in shades of brown and bronze. Extending to the right on a rectangular base, there is a gold-colored cannon mounted on an arched platform labeled with the words "ARTILLERY BANK" in raised block letters. To the right of the cannon, a standing male figure in uniform with a hat, mustache, and belted coat is rendered in bronze tones. The man is facing the cannon and has one arm extended forward as if he is signaling or pointing. The entire composition is executed in earthy metallic colors, including copper, gold, and bronze, and is positioned on a light tan background. The drawing is highly detailed, capturing the texture and features of the objects with a sense of depth and shading.
title: Mechanical Artillery Bank
